verdict.rationale: Clerky handles document signing: users 'sign documents on Clerky', and the audit log records who changed what. Stronger signer identity verification is therefore a fair question for this product. However, the evidence never mentions SMS, ID-check, or knowledge-based verification, or any way to require them on sensitive documents.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can require stronger signer identity verification (SMS, ID check, knowledge-based) on sensitive documents
